correctness.rationale: Gamma ratios for monomial fractional integrals yield the cubic order polynomial after removing x^alpha and rescaling. In homogeneous [T:X:W], the inverse change W=(V+a1 U+3a0 Z)/(4a0) is defined for all projective points because a0!=0, and exact symbolic substitution gives 8a0 F=V²Z-f_homog(U,Z). With a3!=0 the only point at Z=0 is [0:1:0] and is smooth, with its tangent of multiplicity three. In affine chart singularity requires v=0=f(u)=f'(u); a degree-three f has at most one distinct multiple root, yielding node at double root and cusp at triple root; odd degree ensures irreducibility. Symbolic discriminant/E=cubic-subdiscriminant give cusp iff a2=-a1²/(48a0), a1³=162a0²a3; monic Weierstrass c4 and discriminant yield exact j. Independently checked the projective, discriminant and cusp identities in SymPy and all 3 example types. Standard genus theory gives genus one versus rational normalization.
